axisReviews.evidence: Electoral competition, civil-rights voting protections and civilian constitutional government were defended.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: The steel seizure exceeded presidential authority and was reversed by the Supreme Court; wartime initiative qualifies uncomplicated legislative restraint.

axisReviews.evidence: Civil liberties coexist with loyalty screening, national intelligence and coercive action during strikes.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He vetoed the McCarran Internal Security Act and rejected some excesses of anti-communism; modern digital surveillance is an analogy.

axisReviews.evidence: Equal citizenship and desegregation were advanced within a shared American national identity.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: His personal racial prejudices and earlier segregation preferences contradict an unqualified pluralist portrayal.

axisReviews.evidence: He supported more liberal immigration laws and vetoed the restrictive 1952 immigration act.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Cold War screening and regulated admission remained; liberalisation did not establish an unconditional settlement entitlement.

axisReviews.evidence: Containment, atomic warfare decisions and the Korean War required substantial military capacity and willingness to use force.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He refused MacArthur’s wider-war proposals and supported international negotiation; escalation restraint should be retained.

axisReviews.evidence: The UN, NATO and Marshall Plan establish international commitments beyond short-term national advantage.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: US sovereignty and national currency remained; the programme did not advocate a world political federation.

axisReviews.evidence: Fair Deal public housing and TVA-style development coexist with private industry and private medical provision.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: National health insurance is financing, not a programme to nationalise every hospital. Temporary seizure differs from ordinary ownership.

axisReviews.evidence: Reciprocal trade and opposition to isolationist tariffs support international market access.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Agricultural support and domestic procurement priorities qualify fully unconditional free trade.

axisReviews.evidence: Reconversion price controls, full-employment proposals and minimum wages accompany a civilian market economy.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: War and Korean mobilisation justify stronger direction than ordinary production; compulsory normal-time economy-wide planning is a mixed estimate.

axisReviews.evidence: The Fair Deal expanded pensions, minimum wages, housing assistance and public welfare ambitions.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He did not propose general confiscation of wealth or agricultural collectivisation; land redistribution is conditional.

axisReviews.evidence: Constitutional civil authority and religious freedom coexist with public prayer and Christian conventions.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Baptist faith and religious ceremony do not imply sectarian national legislation or clergy-appointed government.

axisReviews.evidence: Civil-rights reform coexists with mid-century family and sex-role conventions.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Race equality does not establish endorsement of present-day abortion, same-sex marriage or gender curricula; these are disclosed extrapolations.

axisReviews.evidence: Atomic science and public infrastructure favoured technological development.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Civilian biomedical enhancement was not addressed; support for science alone does not settle irreversible human experimentation.

axisReviews.evidence: Federal civil-rights enforcement and social programmes require effective national authority.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: States retained constitutions, taxation and ordinary policing; national rights protection is not abolition of federalism.

axisReviews.evidence: Civil-rights legislation addresses learned prejudice and barriers to opportunity.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Personal racist language complicates the picture but does not document a heredity theory; mixed responses separate equality of rights from biological causal claims.
